_comments.rules: Standard 8x8 checkers (English draughts). Men move diagonally forward, kings move diagonally in any direction. Captures are mandatory. Multi-jumps allowed.
_comments.checkers_moves: Built-in parameter selector that enumerates all legal moves (simple moves and jumps) for the current player.
_comments.checkers_execute: Built-in effect that applies a move: moves piece, removes captured pieces, promotes to king if reaching last row.
_comments.must_jump_from: If non-empty, the current player must continue jumping from this position (multi-jump).
